summary: Implemented compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults on ClientArgsCreator (botocore/args.py), added the EndpointResolverBuiltins str enum (botocore/regions.py), made the STS global-endpoint predicate accept a missing endpoint config, and added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (24 tests) to tests/unit/test_args.py. All 59 tests in test_args.py pass. The full unit suite has 11 failures in test_awsrequest.py, test_session.py and test_session_legacy.py; the same 11 fail on the original code, so they predate this change. Choices: the SDK::Endpoint key is present with value None when absent; Accelerate and MRAP pass raw config values through without boolean coercion. Nothing is committed. Lint (black/isort) was not run because the tools are not in the prepared venv.
